Generate a random MultiFactor or LinkMap

randomMultiFactor.Rd

Randomly generate a valid MultiFactor or LinkMap object.

called by randomMultiFactor, shouldn't be called by user.

Usage

randomMultiFactor(n_types = 6, n_features = 100, sparseness = 0.5)

randomLinkMap(x = list(lower = letters, UPPER = LETTERS), sparseness = 0.5)

Arguments

n_types

Numeric scalar, number of types of features to generate

n_features

Numeric scalar, number of features per type

sparseness

Numeric scalar, proportion: How rare are connections. Default is 0.5.

x

optional list of two named vectors of features to use. Default is list(lower = letters, UPPER = LETTERS).

Value

a randomly generated object of the specified class.

See also

MultiFactor()

LinkMap()

Examples

# Make a random MultiFactor object
randomMultiFactor()
#> A MultiFactor::MultiFactor list S7_object,
#>     6 feature types across 5 LinkMaps.
#> 
#>       a   b   c   d   e   f
#> a2b 100 100   .   .   .   .
#> b2c   . 100 100   .   .   .
#> c2d   .   . 100 100   .   .
#> d2e   .   .   . 100 100   .
#> e2f   .   .   .   . 100 100
#> 
#> Values represent unique feature names in that LinkMap.
#> 
#> Levels:
#> a : 100 Levels: a_001 a_002 ... a_100 
#> b : 100 Levels: b_001 b_002 ... b_100 
#> c : 100 Levels: c_001 c_002 ... c_100 
#> d : 100 Levels: d_001 d_002 ... d_100 
#> e : 100 Levels: e_001 e_002 ... e_100 
#> f : 100 Levels: f_001 f_002 ... f_100 

# Make a random LinkMap object
randomLinkMap()
